description: Systematically interrogates a worldbuilding decision, lore proposal, or science derivation through exhaustive questioning until all implications, contradictions, and dependencies are resolved. Use when stress-testing a new concept, validating a proposed rule, or when user says "grill me", "stress test this", "what are the implications", "does this break anything", "think through this with me", "challenge this idea", or "red team this". Does NOT write content — interrogation only.
